title: A Bit of Fry & Laurie   Concerning Language
summary: A Fry and Laurie sketch about language, full of absurd phrases and wordplay, which also plays on the distinction between langue and parole.
why: HN quotes it jokingly when talk turns to nonsense language, and one commenter points out its underlying linguistics.

quote.text: behind the silliness and ridiculous characterization, sets out Ferdinand de Saussure’s distinction of langue versus parole
